+ आगार भाण्ड- + आगार,
 I. m. a store-room.
 II. n. a treasury,
Rājat. 5, 10
+ पति भाण्ड- + पति, m. a merchant, Pañc. 26, 25.
+ पुट भाण्ड- + पुट, m. a barber.
+ पुष्प भाण्ड- + पुष्प, m. a sort of snake.
भण् (a dialectical form based on भाष् + णा, i. e. भाष् ii. 9), i. 1, Par. To speak,
Lass. 21, 3

. भणित, Spoken, Pañc. 128, 5; sounded.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 38. प्रतिभणित, Answered.
† भण्ट् भण्ट्, i. 10, Par. To deceive.

† भण्ड् भण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To upbraid; to reprove.
 2. To jest.
 3. To deride.
 4. To speak.
 --i. 10 or 1, Par. To be, and to make fortunate; to do an auspicious act.

भण्डन, n.
 1.

Armour.
 2

Battle.
 3
. Evil.

and भण्डी भण्डी̆, f.
 1. A wave.
 2. A plant, Rubia manjith Roxb.
 --Comp.

भण्डिल (probably a dialectical form, akin to भद्र),
 I. adj.
 1.

Fortunate.
 2

. A messenger.
 II. m. A tree, Mimosa sirisha.
भाण्डिल, i. e. भाण्ड + इल, m. A barber.

भाण्ड, n.
 1. Any vessel, a pot, a cup, Pañc. 96, 18;
. Any implement or utensil,

. The capital, principal of a merchant.
 4. Goods, wares, Pañc. 7, 17 (देश-अन्तर-भाण्ड-आनयन, n. Exporting wares to foreign countries), i. d. 19.
 5. An ornament, Daśak. in
. Any musical instrument,

. The bed of a river.
 --Comp.
भाण्डायन, n. A proper name, Utt.
Rāmac. 91, 8
भाण्डिक, i. e. भाण्ड + इक, m. A musician.
